Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXX OF 1975
ACT XXX OF 1975
BOILERS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Boilers Act, 1923
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th March 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 1st March 1975, and is hereby
published for general information : -
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Boilers (Amendment) Act,
1975.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 27-A, Act V of 1923

ACT XXX OF 1975
ACT XXX OF 1975
BOILERS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act further to
amend the Boilers Act, 1923
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th March 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 1st March 1975, and is hereby
published for general information : -
2. Amendment of section 27-A,
Act V of 1923.---In the Boilers Act, 1923 (V of 1923), in section 27-A, for
subsection (2) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"(2) The Board shall consist
of the following members, namely :---
(a) A Chairman to be nominated by
the Federal Government ;
(b) one member to be nominated by
each of the Provincial Governments
(c) one member to be nominated by
the Pakistan Railways ; and
(d) such other members as the Federal Government may, by
notification the official Gazette, nominate.".
